tagline: Global leader in industrial tools, machinery, and digital solutions for mining, construction, and manufacturing
hero_kpi_rationale: Adjusted EBITA margin reflects Sandvik's core operating profitability, excluding non-recurring items.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenues from sales of goods and services generated by the company.
kpis.description: Q1 2026 revenues reached SEK 30,685 million, up 5% from Q1 2025 (SEK 29,301 million). At fixed exchange rates, revenues increased by 15%, and organically by 15%, demonstrating strong underlying demand across mining, construction, and machining segments.
kpis.signal: Moderate revenue growth of 5% YoY, with 15% growth at fixed exchange rates and organically.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITA Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit margin (EBITA) adjusted for items affecting comparability, expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITA increased by 6% to SEK 6,138 million with a margin of 20.0% (Q1 2025: 19.7%). This reflects operational excellence and successful execution of the profit growth strategy despite currency headwinds and restructuring costs in Machining.
kpis.signal: Strong operating efficiency with adjusted EBITA margin at 20.0%, up from 19.7% in Q1 2025, within Sandvik's target…

kpis.name: Order Intake
kpis.explanation: Total value of new customer orders received during the period, indicating future revenue potential and demand strength.
kpis.description: Total order intake in Q1 2026 increased to SEK 36,756 million from SEK 32,763 million in Q1 2025. At fixed exchange rates, order intake grew by 23%, and organically by 23%, reflecting strong broad-based demand in Mining, Rock Processing, Machining, and Intelligent Manufacturing.
kpis.signal: Strong order intake growth of 12% YoY, with 23% growth at fixed exchange rates and organically, indicating robust…

kpis.name: Free Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from operations after capital expenditures, representing cash available for debt repayment and shareholder returns.
kpis.description: Free operating cash flow in Q1 2026 was SEK 3,613 million compared to SEK 3,809 million in Q1 2025 (-5% YoY). Cash conversion rate of 62% is healthy and consistent with seasonal patterns. Full year 2025 free operating cash flow was SEK 21,216 million.
kpis.signal: Free operating cash flow of SEK 3.6 billion with 62% cash conversion, in line with normal seasonality despite -5%…

kpis.name: Adjusted EBIT Margin
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest and taxes (adjusted for items affecting comparability) expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBIT reached SEK 5,719 million in Q1 2026, up 9% from SEK 5,262 million in Q1 2025, with margin expanding to 18.6% from 18.0%. Full year 2025 adjusted EBIT margin was 17.8%.
kpis.signal: Adjusted EBIT margin improved to 18.6% in Q1 2026 from 18.0% in Q1 2025, demonstrating continued operational leverage.

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.explanation: Net profit attributable to shareholders divided by weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Earnings per share (diluted) increased to SEK 3.09 in Q1 2026 from SEK 2.97 in Q1 2025 (+4%). Adjusted EPS diluted increased 8% to SEK 3.27 from SEK 3.01. Full year 2025 EPS was SEK 11.70 with adjusted EPS of SEK 12.17.
kpis.signal: EPS diluted grew 4% to SEK 3.09, with adjusted EPS growing 8% to SEK 3.27, reflecting strong profitability.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 6.0 SEK in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 7.203 Bn SEK in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 49.0% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Mining Organic Order Growth
kpis.explanation: Organic growth rate of order intake in the Mining business segment, excluding acquisitions and currency effects.
kpis.description: Mining segment achieved 22% organic order intake growth in Q1 2026, with double-digit expansion in both equipment and aftermarket. Strong demand for AutoMine automation solutions, highlighted by multiple orders from a major customer now operating globally with AutoMine technology.
kpis.signal: Exceptional organic order growth in Mining with double-digit growth in both equipment and aftermarket.

kpis.name: Machining Organic Order Growth
kpis.explanation: Organic growth rate of order intake in the Machining business segment, driven by strong demand in strategic end-markets.
kpis.description: Machining reported exceptional 28% organic order intake growth in Q1 2026. Powder business more than doubled, cutting tools grew 18%. Strong demand in aerospace, defense, and medical segments, with significant benefit from favorable global tungsten market dynamics and vertical supply chain integration.
kpis.signal: Exceptional 28% organic order intake growth driven by aerospace, defense, medical segments and tungsten market dynamics.

kpis.name: Rock Processing Organic Order Growth
kpis.explanation: Organic growth rate of order intake in the Rock Processing business segment.
kpis.description: Rock Processing achieved 12% organic order intake growth in Q1 2026, driven by equipment orders. Q1 is a key indicator for underlying infrastructure market sentiment with pre-ordering ahead of summer activities. Strong pre-ordering and recovery in demolition and recycling, as well as aggregates.
kpis.signal: Strong organic order growth of 12% in Rock Processing driven by equipment demand and infrastructure sentiment.

kpis.name: Intelligent Manufacturing Organic Growth
kpis.explanation: Combined organic growth of order intake and revenues for the new Intelligent Manufacturing standalone business area.
kpis.description: Intelligent Manufacturing, launching as a standalone business area in Q1 2026, achieved 11% organic growth in both order intake and revenues. Strong performance in North America and aerospace/defense segments. Subscription revenues grew high-double-digits, supporting strategic shift toward recurring revenue models.
kpis.signal: Solid 11% organic growth in software and digital solutions with high-double-digit subscription growth.

risks.title: Exposure to geopolitical and macroeconomic risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned at the top of the strategic risk section, with broad language ('geopolitical and environmental developments') affecting the long term. Risk is stable but structural for a global group present on all continents. The geopolitical category carries high weight in the assessment.

risks.title: Currency risk due to geographic dispersion
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited among financial risks in the dedicated risk section. Exchange rate differences generated an impact of -8,440 MSEK in Q1 2025 on other comprehensive income items, illustrating materiality. Risk is stable and recurring for a multi-currency group.

risks.title: Rising tariffs and trade barriers
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the list of financial risks with direct wording ('increased trade tariffs'). Positioned in the risk section of the report, within a global context of rising protectionism. The regulatory category carries high weight. Trend is increasing compared to previous years.

risks.title: Raw material price volatility risk
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited among financial risks in the dedicated section. Group gross margin declined from 42.4% to 40.2% between Q1 2025 and Q1 2026, illustrating cost pressure. Risk is stable and inherent to Sandvik's industrial operations.

risks.title: Sector-specific technological disruption risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned at the top of the strategic risk section under 'technological shifts', with a long-term horizon. The group invested 1,111 MSEK in R&D in Q1 2026, indicating this risk is taken seriously. Risk is stable but structural in the tooling and mining sectors.

risks.title: Environmental and sustainability risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited among strategic and sustainability risks in the dedicated section. The environmental category is increasingly scrutinized by regulators and investors. Risk is rising due to tightening ESG requirements in Europe.

risks.title: Restructuring costs weighing on profitability
risks.score_rationale: Items affecting comparability (IAC) amounted to -389 MSEK in Q1 2026, including -315 MSEK of restructuring costs in the Machining division, described as 'second phase'. Positioned mid-report with factual language but significant amounts. Trend is increasing compared to Q1 2025 (-56 MSEK).

ai_positioning.summary: Sandvik integrates digital solutions and automation in its industrial equipment and processes, enhancing efficiency and productivity. The newly standalone Intelligent Manufacturing business area focuses on software, digital services, and subscription-based solutions. While not a direct AI developer, Sandvik uses digital technologies and data analytics to optimize operations and strengthen competitive positioning.
evidence: Launched My Sandvik Geo, an advanced cloud-based digital service for drilling data transformation.
Strong growth in Intelligent Manufacturing segment with software and subscription solutions.
Multiple new digital product launches including software versions and connected equipment offerings.
Acquisition of ThoroughTec Simulation to strengthen digital and aftermarket capabilities.
